chapterTag.category: AP Calc BC BC-1 — Advanced Integration

body.en: BC extends the integral toolkit with integration by parts, partial fractions, and improper integrals over infinite or unbounded intervals.

By parts: \( \displaystyle\int u\,dv=uv-\int v\,du \). Partial fractions split a rational integrand into simpler pieces. Improper integrals are limits: \( \displaystyle\int_a^{\infty} f=\lim_{b\to\infty}\int_a^{b} f \).

figure.title: Improper Integral: Area Under f(x) = 1/x² from x = 1 to ∞

caption.en: The improper integral \( \int_1^\infty \frac{1}{x^2}\,dx = \lim_{b\to\infty} \left[1 - \frac{1}{b}\right] = 1 \). Even though the domain extends infinitely along the horizontal axis, the accumulated area converges to exactly \( 1 \).

label.en: ⚠️ AP Exam Traps: Advanced Integration Techniques

body.en:
• Mandatory Limit Notation on FRQs: You cannot plug \( \infty \) directly into an antiderivative bracket on the AP Exam. Writing \( \left[-\frac{1}{x}\right]_1^\infty \) loses the setup point. You MUST replace \( \infty \) with a dummy variable and take the limit: \( \lim_{b\to\infty} \int_1^b \frac{1}{x^2}\,dx = \lim_{b\to\infty}\left[-\frac{1}{x}\right]_1^b \).
  • Integration by Parts Sign Distribution: In \( \int u\,dv = uv - \int v\,du \), when performing repeated IBP or when \( v \) contains a negative sign (e.g. \( \int \sin(x)dx = -\cos(x) \)), parenthesize carefully: \( -(-uv) \) turns into a \( + \), and a negative outside distributed over an inner subtraction is the single most frequent calculation error.
  • Improper Integrals with Interior Discontinuities: Watch out for integrals like \( \int_{-1}^1 \frac{1}{x^2}\,dx \). The integrand is undefined at \( x=0 \), so you cannot apply the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus directly. It must be split into \( \int_{-1}^0 \frac{1}{x^2}\,dx + \int_0^1 \frac{1}{x^2}\,dx \), both of which diverge to \( \infty \).
  • LIATE Priority Rule for Parts: Pick \( u \) following Logarithmic, Inverse trig, Algebraic (polynomials), Trigonometric, Exponential. Differentiate \( u \) and integrate \( dv \).
Evaluate \( \displaystyle\int x e^{x}\,dx \) with \( u=x,\ dv=e^{x}dx \). \[ x e^{x}-\int e^{x}\,dx=(x-1)e^{x}+C. \]

Evaluate \(\displaystyle\int x^2 e^x\,dx\).

Apply IBP twice. Let \(u=x^2,\,dv=e^x dx\): \(x^2e^x-2\int xe^x dx\).

For \(\int xe^x dx\): \(u=x,\,dv=e^x dx\Rightarrow xe^x-e^x\).

\[\int x^2e^x\,dx=x^2e^x-2xe^x+2e^x+c=e^x(x^2-2x+2)+c.\]

question.en: Determine whether \(\displaystyle\int_1^\infty\frac{1}{x^2}\,dx\) converges, and if so find its value.
Evaluate the definite integral \(\displaystyle\int_0^\pi x \sin x\,dx\) using integration by parts.

solution.en: Let \(u = x\) and \(dv = \sin x\,dx\). Then \(du = dx\) and \(v = -\cos x\). Applying IBP: \(\int x\sin x\,dx = -x\cos x - \int(-\cos x)\,dx = -x\cos x + \sin x\). Evaluating from \(0\) to \(\pi\): \([-\pi\cos(\pi) + \sin(\pi)] - [-0\cos(0) + \sin(0)] = [-\pi(-1) + 0] - 0 = \pi\).
